title: Execution of the generated program
statement: Let $v$ assign a natural number to each of the three indices $0,1,2$, and let $\varphi$ be a CNF formula over natural-number variables. The bit string obtained by executing the program generated from $\varphi$ under $v$ is the body encoding of the formula obtained by replacing each literal $(x,b)$ with $(v(x \bmod 3),b)$, preserving its polarity bit.
hypotheses_covered: A function from the three indices to natural numbers
A CNF formula over natural-number variables
